correctness.rationale: Proved from an exact directed epidemic-percolation construction. A same-peripheral two-arc overlap has o(1/n) probability at the critical scale using E[J]<infinity; conditional Poisson counts yield independent core arcs. Uniform conditional binomial approximation over all 2^b core subsets yields the joint infection-count limit. Endpoint regimes follow union/product bounds. The b=2 Markovian law, Laplace transform and exact binomial formulas have independent exact-state CTMC checks (70 rational equalities). Finite tests are not used as a substitute for infinite proof.

value.rationale: The object is the natural sparse-to-mesoscopic SIR crossing regime on an extreme two-type graph, not an arbitrary slice. The theorem gives the actual random finite-core cascade and the correlated peripheral infected count simultaneously, including boundaries on each side of the square-root contact scaling. The explicit b=2 Laplace distribution and exact finite formulas offer a sharp interpretable benchmark for heterogeneous-source epidemic studies; the known general percolation representation and SIS spectral scale alone do not state this claim.
